messages:
sam: Heads-up: opened PR to consolidate rate-limit examples across sdk snippets and pricing page. Mainly: clarify tiered metering math, replace deprecated header `x-rw-usage`, and fix the console dashboard link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4991

olivia: Nice. Can you include an explicit example that shows how burst credits affect short vs long requests? Our customers keep asking for a simple rule-of-thumb.

sam: Yep planning a 2-row table + tiny python/curl snippets. Also swapping the dashboard link to the new panel permalink; asked eng-infra about permissions.

kai: Quick note: the SDK helper returns consumption in nested objects now (`consumption.tiers[0].remaining`), so examples need to parse that. Otherwise people will copy-paste and break.

lee: Also add a one-liner about eventual consistency on quota endpoints (~45-90s). I had a user report where UI lagged after a quota refill.

sam: Good call, added eventual consistency note and a short "how to check burst before you send" snippet. Example: `remaining = resp.json()["consumption"]["tiers"][0]["remaining_burst"]` then adjust batch size.

olivia: Can we avoid showing exact pricing math in the doc? Legal prefers linking out to the pricing table instead of hardcoded per-token numbers. Show formulas with variables instead.

sam: Updated table to use variables, added sample computation in comments (not in live text). Also removed hard numbers and linked pricing page.

kai: I verified the header name and SDK response shape. CI will catch lint but I left a comment suggesting we add a tiny unit test fixture for the snippet.

docs-bot: PR sam/4991 opened  reviewers requested: olivia, kai. Checks queued: linkcheck, snippet-lint, spellcheck.

lee: Left two tiny copy nits. Non-blocking.

olivia: Approved pending the eng-infra panel-perm confirmation.

sam: Eng-infra confirmed the panel permalink and I pushed the panel uid into the PR. Merging after CI green. Will post a short note in #release-notes and backport to the 1.x docs branch.

docs-bot: PR merged by sam. CI: green. Backport issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/782

sam: Follow-up: added a short FAQ entry in the pricing docs about "what counts against burst" and linked the sdk snippet. Closing thread.
